biography: João Cury, born in the vibrant city of São Paulo, discovered his passion for racing amidst the roaring engines of local karting circuits. His father, a mechanic, instilled in him a deep understanding of car mechanics and a relentless pursuit of perfection. João's breakthrough came at age 19 when he won the São Paulo Karting Championship, earning him a scholarship to a racing academy. Despite facing financial constraints and fierce competition, João persevered, his calculating nature allowing him to anticipate opponents' moves and optimize his performance. He made a name for himself in Copa Fusca, where his meticulous approach and strategic brilliance led to numerous podium finishes. After years of struggling to find top-tier rides, he caught his big break joining T.Donut Skin team in Copa Fusca where he's looking to turn his consistent finishes into a championship.
drivingStyle: João's driving style is characterized by precision and calculation. He's known for his meticulous corner entries, patiently setting up the car for optimal exit speed. Tire management is a strong suit; he can nurse his tires through long stints while maintaining competitive pace. Under pressure, João remains remarkably calm, rarely making rash decisions. This allows him to capitalize on other drivers' mistakes and secure crucial points.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Esteves
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Ricardo's aggressive style clashes with João's calculated approach.

rivalries.name: Isabela Vieira
rivalries.reason: They fought tooth and nail for the Copa Fusca championship, resulting in some on-track collisions and heated exchanges.

rivalries.name: Mateus Oliveira
rivalries.reason: An emerging talent who challenges João's status as the 'master strategist' of the Copa Fusca series.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, on race day.
Studies telemetry data obsessively, searching for any marginal gains.
Before each race, he listens to a specific bossa nova track to center himself and block out the noise.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about brute force; it's about understanding the equation and solving it before your rivals do."
careerHighlight: Winning the Interlagos Copa Fusca race in 2021, a home victory that solidified his reputation as a formidable competitor. He expertly managed his tires in the scorching heat to clinch the win in the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the final corner of the 2020 Rio de Janeiro race. An over-ambitious move cost him a certain victory and dented his confidence for several weeks.
